content_sections.heading: CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR IHBT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies for Various Project Positions in the CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026. These positions are distributed across different project codes and roles.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for CSIR IHBT Various Project Positions?
faq.answer: The mode of application for the Various Project Positions at CSIR IHBT is Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified dates.

faq.question: Q3. What are the age limits for the CSIR IHBT Project Positions?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for these posts should be between 35 and 40 years of age. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women (5 years) and OBC (3 years).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the Various Project Positions at CSIR IHBT?
faq.answer: The salary for the Various Project Positions ranges from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,000 per month, along with applicable HRA, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q5. What are the important dates for the walk-in interviews?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on multiple dates: 18 August 2026 for codes 14001-14003, 19 August 2026 for codes 14004-14009, 20 August 2026 for codes 14010-14015, and 21 August 2026 for codes 14016-14017.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Project Assistant-I (PA-I) posts?
faq.answer: For Project Assistant-I (PA-I) posts (Code 14001 and 14006), candidates must have SSC/10th plus ITI qualification. Specific trade details should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the CSIR IHBT Various Project Positions Recruitment 2026. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), category certificate, and extra passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interviews be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be conducted at the CSIR Institute of Himalayan Bioresource Technology (CSIR IHBT) office in Palampur, Himachal Pradesh. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Various Project Positions at CSIR IHBT is based solely on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed on their qualifications, experience, and performance in the interview.
